audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for Spirit-led wilderness testing, Greek testing/adversary language, scripture replies, kingdoms temptation, messenger service, Galilee light citation, metanoeite/basileia proclamation, first disciples, healing summary.

verses.restored: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tested by the adversarial one.

familiar.text: Then was Jesus led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.

verses.restored: After fasting forty days and forty nights, he was hungry.

familiar.text: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward an hungred.

verses.restored: The tester came and said to him, If you are Son of the Divine, speak so that these stones may become loaves of bread.

familiar.text: And when the tempter came to him, he said, If thou be the Son of God, command that these stones be made bread.

verses.restored: But he answered, It has been written: A human shall not live by bread alone, but by every word going out through the mouth of the Divine.

familiar.text: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.

verses.restored: Then the adversarial one took him into the holy city and stood him on the pinnacle of the temple.

familiar.text: Then the devil taketh him up into the holy city, and setteth him on a pinnacle of the temple,

verses.restored: He said to him, If you are Son of the Divine, throw yourself down, for it has been written: He will command his messengers concerning you, and on their hands they will lift you up, lest you strike your foot against a stone.

familiar.text: And saith unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.

verses.restored: Jesus said to him, Again it has been written: You shall not test the Lord your God.

familiar.text: Jesus said unto him, It is written again, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.

verses.restored: Again, the adversarial one took him to a very high mountain and showed him all the realms of the world and their glory.

familiar.text: Again, the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain, and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;

verses.restored: He said to him, All these I will give you, if you fall down and bow/prostrate before me.

familiar.text: And saith unto him, All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.

verses.restored: Then Jesus said to him, Go away, adversary, for it has been written: You shall bow/prostrate before the Lord your God, and him alone you shall serve.

familiar.text: Then saith Jesus unto him, Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.

verses.restored: Then the adversarial one left him, and look, messengers came and served him.

familiar.text: Then the devil leaveth him, and, behold, angels came and ministered unto him.

verses.restored: When Jesus heard that John had been handed over, he withdrew into Galilee.

familiar.text: Now when Jesus had heard that John was cast into prison, he departed into Galilee;

verses.restored: Leaving Nazareth, he came and dwelled in Capernaum by the sea, in the territories of Zebulun and Naphtali,

familiar.text: And leaving Nazareth, he came and dwelt in Capernaum, which is upon the sea coast, in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim:

verses.restored: so that what was spoken through Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, saying:

familiar.text: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,

verses.restored: Land of Zebulun and land of Naphtali, way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations,

familiar.text: The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles;

verses.restored: the people sitting in darkness saw a great light, and for those sitting in the region and shadow of death, light rose for them.

familiar.text: The people which sat in darkness saw great light; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up.

verses.restored: From then Jesus began to proclaim and say, Turn and realign your mind/heart, for the reign of the heavens has drawn near.

familiar.text: From that time Jesus began to preach, and to say, Repent: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.

verses.restored: Walking beside the Sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers, Simon called Peter and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea, for they were fishers.

familiar.text: And Jesus, walking by the sea of Galilee, saw two brethren, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.

verses.restored: He said to them, Come after me, and I will make you fishers of people.

familiar.text: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.

verses.restored: Immediately they left the nets and followed him.

familiar.text: And they straightway left their nets, and followed him.

verses.restored: Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James son of Zebedee and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets, and he called them.

familiar.text: And going on from thence, he saw other two brethren, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in a ship with Zebedee their father, mending their nets; and he called them.

verses.restored: Immediately they left the boat and their father and followed him.

familiar.text: And they immediately left the ship and their father, and followed him.

verses.restored: Jesus went around all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, proclaiming the good message of the reign, and healing every disease and every weakness among the people.

familiar.text: And Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of sickness and all manner of disease among the people.

verses.restored: The report about him went out into all Syria, and they brought to him all who were sick, held by various diseases and torments, those troubled by unclean spirits, those with seizures, and paralyzed people, and he healed them.

familiar.text: And his fame went throughout all Syria: and they brought unto him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments, and those which were possessed with devils, and those which were lunatick, and those that had the palsy; and he healed them.

verses.restored: Great crowds followed him from Galilee, the Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and beyond the Jordan.

familiar.text: And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee, and from Decapolis, and from Jerusalem, and from Judaea, and from beyond Jordan.
